items.summary: Scaffold for registered reports, preregistrations, and replications — freezes hypotheses, outcomes, exclusion rules, and the analysis plan into a hash-stamped ledger, logs every deviation, and audits claims so confirmatory and exploratory results stay separate. Emits hypothesis-outcome maps, analysis DAGs, deviation timelines, permutation tests.

items.title: docxology/template_search_project
items.summary: Scaffold for literature review and evidence synthesis — searches arXiv, Crossref, and local corpora, deduplicates hits, enriches abstracts and fulltext, then runs local Ollama (gemma3:4b) per-paper and corpus-level synthesis into references.bib, reading_report.md, corpus.json, and coverage plots. Deterministic caching, pinned seeds.

items.title: docxology/template_sia
items.summary: Evaluation harness scaffold for self-improvement agents (SIA) — runs a Meta to Target to Feedback loop across generations, scores runs on the mini_classify task with split public/private data to catch overfitting, and replays recorded_generations fixtures for deterministic reruns. Python, uv, pytest; swap your agent into src/loop.py.

items.title: docxology/template_storybook
items.summary: Scaffold for illustrated picture books — renders a full-page PDF storybook from content/story.yaml using ReportLab and procedural graphics, with per-page scripts you can add, remove, or reorder, plus PNG plates, contact sheet, and render manifest. Demo: 14 pages on Tessa the tetrahedron and Ciro the cube.

items.title: docxology/template_template
items.summary: Reference exemplar of the docxology template family — a self-describing repo whose manuscript regenerates from its own codebase: introspection walks the YAML pipeline DAG and module inventory, a metrics engine fills tokens, and scripts draw architecture diagrams. Ships the 20-platform publishing workflow (Zenodo, PyPI, IPFS, arXiv).

items.title: docxology/template_textbook
items.summary: Project scaffold for book-length manuscripts — declare parts, chapters, labs, and question banks in one config.yaml and get auto-numbering, cross-references, deterministic matplotlib figures and Mermaid diagrams, and PDF/HTML/EPUB/DOCX output. Structural-contract pytest suite at 90%+ coverage; uv-managed.

items.title: docxology/test_public
items.summary: Scratch test repository — one .gitattributes file, no code or documentation. Exists for testing GitHub repository setup and tooling.

items.title: docxology/thalia
items.summary: THALIA is a typed agentic harness pairing DSPy compiler-driven optimization with layered memory — Inspector, BM25/embedding hybrid Retriever, cited Reasoner, append-only SQLite memory gate, and MIPRO/GEPA-style config search. Deterministic, zero-mock pytest at 90%+ coverage, evaluated on LongMemEval_S.

items.title: docxology/timeline_generator
items.summary: Browser-based temporal knowledge graph for biographical networks: React 18 and D3 force-directed views over a Fastify 4 + Neo4j 5 backend, 24 weighted relationship types with confidence scores, timeline date brushing, Perplexity-powered figure research, 18 REST endpoints, 204 passing tests.

items.title: docxology/transformer
items.summary: First-principles transformer implementation in PyTorch built for interpretability rather than speed — traces the residual stream and K/V attention pathways (6 layers x 32 positions = 2.3 million paths) with 20+ visualizations, 7 preset configs from debug to xlarge, and 74 tests.

items.title: docxology/ultralink-docx
items.summary: UltraLink — JavaScript/Node knowledge-graph framework for entities, typed relationships, and temporal versioning, with vector embeddings for semantic similarity. Exports one graph to JSON, GraphML, CSV, Obsidian markdown, interactive D3.js sites, and a compressed full-blob format. MIT, on npm.

items.title: docxology/white_line
items.summary: Absence ledger for the four-line governance set: records epistemic gaps, withheld claims, and deliberate non-assertion as NAMED, UNRESOLVED, WITHHELD, or NOT_RECORDED, decays dated observations past their review horizon, and exports line.report-envelope/1.0 reports.

items.title: docxology/witness_register
items.summary: Python registry that co-registers audit reports from the four line instruments without merging, scoring, or overriding them: nine-field envelopes keep each line's native status verbatim, typed records capture blocks and tensions, and an append-only digest chain seals the history.
